class.name: SwimmingMode2D
class.brief_description: Moving through water, in two dimensions.
class.description: The 2D twin of [SwimmingMode]. Like [FlyingMode2D] the input is not flattened, so the character swims in whatever direction it points. Unlike flying, gravity is not gone: it is scaled by how much of the capsule is under the surface and by the volume's [member WaterVolume2D.buoyancy], so a character at the surface sinks until it is submerged and then hangs there. The lift half of a stroke is scaled by that same immersion, because there is nothing to push against above the waterline. A character holding [i]up[/i] therefore treads water instead of swimming clean out of the pool; getting out is what the jump is for, and taking it hands over to [code]Falling[/code] in the same tick. Entered and left by [WaterMovementTransition2D], which [CharacterMovementComponent2D] registers by default.
